newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Pirelli Tyre provisional profits up, bid confirmed.
newsitem.headline: Pirelli Tyre provisional profits up, bid confirmed.

text.p: Pirelli Tyre Holding NV said on Monday that it made a provisional net profit of some 95 million guilders ($51.7 million) in 1996, a rise of some 42 million guilders compared with 1995.

Amsterdam-listed Pirelli Tyre is 93.6 percent owned by Italy's Pirelli SpA, which confirmed on Monday that it would make a public offer of 19.50 guilders per share for all outstanding shares of Pirelli Tyre.

In a joint statement Pirelli SpA and Pirelli Tyre said the offer would be open from January 28 to February 24, with Pirelli SpA expected to announce no later than February 27 whether it will go ahead and implement the offer.
Pirelli Tyre will hold an extraordinary meeting of shareholders on February 13 to inform shareholders about the offer.
Pirelli SpA first publicly announced its plans to buy out minority shareholders in Pirelli Tyre at a price of 19.50 guilders per share on January 14.
Pirelli Tyre said its provisional net profit figures were stated after the deduction of profits due to minority interests.
Group net profit before such deductions came to around 150 million guilders, a rise of over 75 percent compared with 1995.
Net sales for 1996 amounted to 5.65 billion guilders, which represented a rise of roughly one percent after elimination of exchange rate movements, Pirelli Tyre said.
The company said it expected to make a "reasonable" profit in 1997 even though demand was expected to remain stagnant. ($ = 1.836 Dutch Guilders)
